nodes.description: Owned.owner - address of the current contract owner, initialized to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Owned.newOwner - pending owner address used by the two-step transferOwnership/acceptOwnership flow.
LOL token symbol string, set to "LOL" in the constructor.
LOL token name string, set to "LOL" in the constructor.
LOL token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply (21000000000000000000000000) assigned in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding allowances; mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd - guarded addition with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub - guarded subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul - guarded multiplication with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv - guarded division with require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing initial access control.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) - onlyOwner function staging a new owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership - requires msg.sender == newOwner then moves owner to newOwner and zeroes newOwner.
LOL() constructor that sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to the fixed deployer address and emits Transfer.
ERC20 totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked raw subtraction.
ERC20 balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer(address to, uint tokens) - debits msg.sender via safeSub, credits 'to' via safeAdd, emits Transfer.
ERC20 approve(address spender, uint tokens) - writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no zero-first check (documented double-spend race).
ERC20 transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) - debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to].
ERC20 allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) - sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval before state is finalized/returned.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that performs an external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary attacker-supplied token address.
Caller-controlled address used as the owner, transfer sender, approver and access-control check subject.
Untrusted external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) inside approveAndCall, executed before the function returns (reentrancy surface).
Arbitrary external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) in transferAnyERC20Token with attacker-influenced target contract.
Unchecked raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() that bypasses SafeMath.
Parameter 'a' of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Parameter 'b' of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf and allowance.
Parameter 'spender' of approve and approveAndCall.
Parameter 'tokens' (amount) of transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall/transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter 'to' (recipient) of transfer and transferFrom.
Parameter 'from' (source account) of transferFrom.
Parameter 'data' forwarded to the spender in approveAndCall.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token, used directly as an external call target.
Local result variable 'c' in the SafeMath helper functions.
Named return local 'balance' of balanceOf.
Named return local 'remaining' of allowance.
Named return local 'success' of the transfer-family functions.

edges.reason: Parameter a flows into safeAdd arithmetic.
Parameter b flows into safeAdd arithmetic.
tokenOwner indexes balances in balanceOf.
spender is written into allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
tokens amount is subtracted/added in transfer.
to is credited in transfer.
from is debited in transferFrom.
data is forwarded in the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
_newOwner is written to newOwner in transferOwnership.
tokenAddress is used as the external call target in transferAnyERC20Token.
Local c receives the result of safeAdd.
Local balance is returned by balanceOf.
Local remaining is returned by allowance.
Local success is returned by transfer.
msg.sender becomes owner in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender keys the sender balance in transfer.
msg.sender keys the allowance owner slot in approve.
msg.sender keys the allowance spender slot in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance slot and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before state change.
msg.sender is authorized as owner and used by owner-gated logic.
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
Owned constructor writes msg.sender into owner.
transferOwnership writes _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor initializes symbol.
Constructor initializes name.
Constructor initializes decimals.
Constructor sets _totalSupply.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances of the fixed deployer address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply performs an unchecked raw subtraction that bypasses SafeMath and may underflow.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer writes sender and recipient balances.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom writes balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to owner.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances and allowance bookkeeping.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
approveAndCall invokes an untrusted external contract via receiveApproval, which can re-enter the token before returning.
A malicious spender contract can call back into approveAndCall/transferFrom during receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on a caller-supplied tokenAddress that can re-enter owner-gated functions.
The arbitrary external token contract can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token during its transfer call.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a is only an arithmetic operand of the SafeMath core function and should be folded into safeAdd.
Parameter b is only an arithmetic operand of the SafeMath core function and should be folded into safeAdd.
tokenOwner is solely used as the lookup key inside balanceOf.
spender is solely used to index the allowance mapping in approve.
tokens is the transferred amount consumed by the transfer core function.
to is the recipient address consumed by the transfer core function.
from is the source account consumed by transferFrom.
data is forwarded by approveAndCall to the external receiveApproval callback.
_newOwner is only stored by transferOwnership and should be merged into it.
tokenAddress becomes the external call target of transferAnyERC20Token and has no standalone meaning.
Local c only holds the result of the SafeMath addition and can be folded into safeAdd.
Local balance is just the named return of balanceOf and should be merged into it.
Local remaining is just the named return of allowance and should be merged into it.
Local success is a constant true return of the transfer core function and can be folded into it.
